theorem Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.assemble (m n : Nat) (scale X cost : Nat → Real) :
  forall {a b R K u v w : Real},
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) a → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) b → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) K → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) v → LE.le
      (OfNat.ofNat 0) w →
  LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a (HPow.hPow (HMul.hMul K R) (OfNat.ofNat 2))) (HMul.hMul b (HMul.hMul K R)))
      (HPow.hPow K (OfNat.ofNat 2)) →
  (forall (i : Nat), LE.le i m → LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) (scale i)) → (forall (i : Nat),
    LT.lt i m → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (X i)) →
  (forall (i : Nat), LT.lt i m → LE.le (scale i) (HMul.hMul R (scale (HAdd.hAdd i (OfNat.ofNat 1))))) → LE.le
      (Real.sqrt (X (OfNat.ofNat 0))) (HMul.hMul K (scale (OfNat.ofNat 0))) →
  (forall (i : Nat),
    LT.lt i m → LE.le (X (HAdd.hAdd i (OfNat.ofNat 1)))
      (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul a (X i))
        (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul b (scale (HAdd.hAdd i (OfNat.ofNat 1)))) (Real.sqrt (X i))))) →
  (forall (i : Nat),
    LT.lt i m → LE.le (cost i)
      (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast n)
        (HAdd.hAdd u
          (HDiv.hDiv
            (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul v (Real.sqrt (X i))) (HMul.hMul w (Real.sqrt (X (HAdd.hAdd i (OfNat.ofNat 1))))))
            (scale (HAdd.hAdd i (OfNat.ofNat 1))))))) →
  And (forall (i : Nat), LE.le i m → LE.le (Real.sqrt (X i)) (HMul.hMul K (scale i)))
    (LE.le (Finset.sum (Finset.range m) (fun (i : Nat) => cost i))
      (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast m)
        (HMul.hMul (Nat.cast n) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd u (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul v K) R)) (HMul.hMul w K))))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.eightTable_legal (pick : Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.Choices) (k n : Nat)
  (hn : LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 1) n)
  (fits :
    LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) k → LT.lt
      (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) (HPow.hPow (OfNat.ofNat 8) k)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) n) :
  Shellsort.PredeterminedOptimum.Legal n (Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.eightTable pick k) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.eightTable_length (pick : Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.Choices) (k : Nat) :
  Eq (List.length (Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.eightTable pick k))
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 3) k) (OfNat.ofNat 1)) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.eight_calibration :
  forall {θ : Real},
  LT.lt θ (HDiv.hDiv (OfNat.ofNat 1) (OfNat.ofNat 64)) → Exists
    (fun (ε : Real) =>
    And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) ε)
      (forall (b : Real),
      Exists
        (fun (K : Real) =>
        And (LT.lt (OfNat.ofNat 0) K)
          (LE.le
            (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd θ ε) (HPow.hPow (HMul.hMul K (OfNat.ofNat 8)) (OfNat.ofNat 2)))
              (HMul.hMul b (HMul.hMul K (OfNat.ofNat 8)))) (HPow.hPow K (OfNat.ofNat 2)))))) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.anchor_admissible (c h : Nat) :
  Iff (Nat.Coprime h (Nat.gcd (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) c) (OfNat.ofNat 2)) (HMul.hMul (OfNat.ofNat 4) c)))
    (Odd h) :=
  _

theorem Shellsort.CatalogueSchedules.mixture_energy :
  forall {n : Nat} (p : Shellsort.RankPlacement n) (g₁ g₂ : Nat) (good bad : Finset Nat) (ν μ : Nat → Real)
    {δ ε fee : Real},
  Eq (Finset.sum bad (fun (x : Nat) => μ x)) (OfNat.ofNat 1) → (forall (h : Nat),
    Membership.mem bad h → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) (μ h)) →
  LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) δ → LE.le δ (OfNat.ofNat 1) → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) ε → LE.le (OfNat.ofNat 0) fee →
  (let Q : Real := Int.cast (Shellsort.RoughGapScaleAssembly.squareDisplacement p);
  let E : Nat → Real :=
    fun (h : Nat) =>
    Int.cast
      (Shellsort.RoughGapScaleAssembly.squareDisplacement
        (Shellsort.gapSort (Shellsort.gapSort (Shellsort.gapSort p g₁) g₂) h));
  LE.le (Finset.sum good (fun (h : Nat) => HMul.hMul (ν h) (E h))) (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul ε Q) fee) → LE.le
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HSub.hSub (OfNat.ofNat 1) δ) (Finset.sum good (fun (h : Nat) => HMul.hMul (ν h) (E h))))
      (HMul.hMul δ (Finset.sum bad (fun (h : Nat) => HMul.hMul (μ h) (E h)))))
    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd ε δ) Q) fee)) :=
  _

axiom propext {a b : Sort 0} : Iff a b → Eq a b

axiom Quot.sound.{u} {α : Sort u} {r : α → α → Sort 0} {a b : α} : r a b → Eq (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk r b)

axiom Classical.choice.{u} {α : Sort u} : Nonempty α → α
